cut: In src/commands/source.rs, use tempfile::tempdir_in for clone staging so drop handles cleanup on clone, validation, and rename failures, and move Entry into the record and borrow it for describe; in src/commands/show.rs, use one renderer for the four Markdown list sections and share the skill and program item schema; in src/commands/list.rs, render the human line alongside each JSON row from the same address and description, removing the second pass and JSON field lookups.
answer: Made all three: add stages in tempfile::Builder::tempdir_in and lets drop clean up (no manual remove_dir_all on each failure), Entry moves into the record and describe borrows it (Clone derives dropped); show renders the four list sections through one loop and shares one name/description item schema for skills and programs; list builds each human line with its JSON row in one pass.
